# YAML API Reference Build

[API index](../README.md) | [Definition schema](../schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docs.api.reference` |
| Source | `definitions/docs.yaml` |
| Tags | documentation, workflow |

Public documentation workflow. Renders the index, authoring schema, and one
page per imported definition by invoking template definitions through
`render:` blocks, then prunes stale generated pages.

### Run Operations

#### Render API index

_No operation description provided._

```render
render:
  definition: docs.definition.template.index
  target_path: '{{ output_dir }}/README.md'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
```

#### Render authoring schema

_No operation description provided._

```render
render:
  definition: docs.definition.template.schema
  target_path: '{{ output_dir }}/schema.md'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
```

#### Render per-definition pages

_No operation description provided._

```render
render:
  definition: docs.definition.template.definition
  arguments:
    definition: '{{ definition }}'
  target_path: '{{ output_dir }}/{{ definition.page_path }}'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
for_each:
  items: runtime.catalog.definitions
  as: definition
```

#### Prune stale definition pages

_No operation description provided._

```invoke
invoke:
  definition: stdlib.docs.prune-definition-pages
  arguments:
    output_dir: '{{ output_dir }}'
    mode: '{{ mode }}'
```
